item.title: Jim Bakker, who built 'PTL Club' televangelism empire, has died at 86
item.description: Jim Bakker, along with his first wife Tammy Faye built an evangelical empire around the hugely successful "The PTL Club" TV show, only to lose it all over a sex scandal and financial crimes.

item.title: Is our fate pre-destined? A new 'East of Eden' adaptation asks again
item.description: John Steinbeck's 1952 epic was first adapted to film in 1955 by director Elia Kazan. Now, Kazan's granddaughter Zoe has directed a new Netflix miniseries, starring Florence Pugh.

item.title: Dennis Hastert, longtime Republican House speaker who went to prison, dies at age 84
item.description: ennis Hastert, whose political legacy as Congress' longest-serving Republican House speaker was later fouled by allegations that he had molested high school athletes during his prior career as a teacher and wrestling coach, has died, a coroner said Monday. He was 84.
item.content:encoded:
ennis Hastert, whose political legacy as Congress' longest-serving Republican House speaker was later fouled by allegations that he had molested high school athletes during his prior career as a teacher and wrestling coach, has died, a coroner said Monday. He was 84.

(Image credit: Christian K. Lee)

item.title: Ayad Akhtar's 'The Radiance' addresses provocative subjects head-on
item.description: Like his previous work, including Homeland Elegies, The Radiance exposes the fissures of American racial, political and economic identity.

item.title: Drones buzz overhead, troops hunker underground in Ukraine's hellish kill zone
item.description: The front line in the Russia-Ukraine war stretches more than 700 miles and has barely moved in four years. Yet straddling this line is the kill zone, dominated by constantly evolving drone technology.

item.description: The FBI and U.S. prosecutors say Wanying Zhang, also know as Heather, surveilled the Taiwanese president's son and his family.

item.description: The ongoing investigation has found the attacker intended to crash the plane into Israel's Ben Gurion International Airport, a person familiar with the matter but not authorized to speak publicly told NPR.

item.title: Nobel medicine prize goes to 3 scientists for research into brain activity
item.description: The Nobel Prize in medicine was awarded Monday to three scientists working on the mechanisms the brain uses to switch on, or off, the activity of individual nerve cells.
